subject: ext-ft
title: EXT.F.------TH.CONT.
description: Diagram in CMBA-20, the first of three on book p264. EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is crossed with TH-CONT (thrust continuance). A branch from the main line leads to (R)ALT-C-PG (the reality of alternative composite progressionalism), which in turn branches to (P)INFO-DOC (the point of idea completion of information documentation), AFI (affinity insight), and PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism). PROG-EXT-FT branches to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and MT-INFO (multi-information), and MT-INFO branches to PER-TRS (perceived transition) and MPP-RDEF.
